name: Trooper Dalrymple
blurb: A state trooper in mirrored shades. Quick off the mark, and fond of the taser.

look.description: A state trooper in grey with a campaign hat that has never once blown off, until today.

meta.notes: M4 cops-3 head start: a second Keys cop for the spawn mix, from the state-trooper side of the law (the tone guide's 'state troopers on the highway'). A made-up name and agency. His id sorts after sgt-pruitt, so an event that fields one cop still fields Pruitt. Crude starting numbers, [default].
